name: audio-tools
description: Audio Tools CLI — speech-to-text, text-to-speech, summarization, audio processing, provider lifecycle, and diagnostics over the audio-tools Connect-RPC API.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.description: Transcribe an audio file

commands.name: transcribe-stream
commands.description: Stream-transcribe an audio file (emits one line per stream event)

flags.name: chunk-bytes
flags.description: Chunk size to feed the stream in bytes (default 32768)

commands.name: formats
commands.description: Show the STT ingress audio-format capability matrix (accepted input codecs + ffmpeg/canonical-PCM status).

commands.name: engines
commands.description: List selectable STT engines (manifest-derived) with availability and the active selection.

commands.name: engine-impact
commands.description: Show the shared-resource impact of switching away from an engine (which other scenarios still use its resource + the stop command). Never stops anything.

commands.name: stream-config
commands.description: Show the resolved streaming STT configuration (engine + operator levers + egress gate + legacy partial-window fields).

commands.name: stream-config-set
commands.description: Update one or more streaming STT levers. Only provided flags are mutated.

flags.name: engine
flags.description: Active STT engine id (see `stt engines`); only the Local tier honors it

flags.name: vad-silence-ms
flags.description: VAD silence window in ms; range 200–3000 (default 1200)

flags.name: overlap-commit-runs
flags.description: Consecutive agreeing runs to commit a prefix; range 2–4 (default 2)

flags.name: overlap-max-stall-rejects
flags.description: Force-commit the freshest hypothesis tail after N consecutive overlap divergence-rejects (bounds tail growth before the max_window_ms net); range 1–10, 0 disables (default 3)

flags.name: hallucination-filter
flags.description: true|false — drop known Whisper silence-hallucination phrases (default true)

flags.name: vad-filter
flags.description: true|false — enable faster-whisper's built-in silence filter on /asr (default true)

flags.name: no-speech-threshold
flags.description: Egress drop when mean no_speech_prob exceeds this AND avg_logprob is below logprob-threshold; range (0,1] (default 0.6)

flags.name: denoise
flags.description: true|false — pre-recognition ffmpeg afftdn denoise on the canonical-PCM stream (Whisper vad/overlap only; needs ffmpeg). Default off

commands.name: speaker-status
commands.description: Show speaker-verification config, resource capability, and enrolled profiles. Notes the Whisper-only protection caveat.

commands.name: speaker-config
commands.description: Update speaker-verification config. Only provided flags are mutated.

flags.name: threshold
flags.description: Cosine-similarity accept threshold; 0..1 (default 0.5; same-speaker high, different low)

flags.name: enabled
flags.description: true|false — master enable for speaker verification

flags.name: profiles
flags.description: Comma-separated profile ids to set as the active binding (replaces the list)

flags.name: bind-profile
flags.description: Append a single profile id to the active binding (reads current list first)

flags.name: reject-behavior
flags.description: drop|show-muted — what to do with a rejected segment (default drop)

flags.name: fallback
flags.description: true|false — let audio through when no profile/resource is available

flags.name: extraction-enabled
flags.description: true|false — isolate the enrolled speaker's voice BEFORE recognition (ingress target extraction; needs an enrolled profile + the extraction-capable resource; default false)

flags.name: min-decision-seconds
flags.description: Warm-up window: voiced seconds that must accrue before the session verifier may reject (0 = server default)

flags.name: score-smoothing
flags.description: EMA alpha 0..1 applied to per-segment scores so the session decision stops swinging (0 = server default)

commands.name: speaker-enroll
commands.description: Append one or more enrollment clips to a voice profile. --file is comma-separated for multi-clip enroll; --activate binds+enables in one step.

flags.name: file
flags.description: Audio file path(s); comma-separated to enroll several clips in one call (each appended)

flags.name: profile
flags.description: Profile id (empty = server-generated; reused across the batch)

flags.name: name
flags.description: Human display name for the profile

flags.name: label
flags.description: Condition label for the clip(s), e.g. laptop-normal or phone-whisper

flags.name: notes
flags.description: Optional notes stored with the profile

flags.name: activate
flags.description: true|false — bind as active profile and enable verification (default off)

commands.name: speaker-clips
commands.description: List the enrollment clips of a speaker profile.

commands.name: speaker-delete-clip
commands.description: Delete one enrollment clip from a profile (recomputes the centroid; deleting the last clip deletes the profile).

commands.name: synthesize
commands.description: Synthesize speech audio from text

commands.name: synthesize-stream
commands.description: Stream-synthesize speech audio (writes frames to --out as they arrive)

commands.name: voices
commands.description: List canonical voices

commands.name: formats
commands.description: Show the TTS egress audio-format capability matrix (producible output containers).

groups.name: summarize
groups.description: Text summarization via the audio-tools summarize chain

commands.name: text
commands.description: Summarize text from --text or stdin

commands.name: transcode
commands.description: Transcode an audio file to WAV (16 kHz mono)

groups.name: settings
groups.description: Provider routing, BYOK credentials, voice overrides

commands.name: provider
commands.description: Show the current provider routing config

commands.name: byok-list
commands.description: List stored BYOK credentials (redacted)

commands.name: byok-upsert
commands.description: Add or replace a BYOK credential

commands.name: byok-delete
commands.description: Delete a BYOK credential

groups.name: usage
groups.description: Inspect usage rows recorded by the provider chains

commands.name: list
commands.description: List recent usage rows

commands.name: summary
commands.description: Show usage summary for the last 24h

groups.name: diagnostics
groups.description: Operator-facing capability suite (STT/TTS/Summarize/Transcode) against bundled fixtures

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run the diagnostics suite and print the per-capability result table (or --json envelope)

commands.name: last
commands.description: Print the most recent suite result (or --json envelope)

groups.name: health
groups.description: Show per-capability provider health (capability/provider/tier/state table; `show` for one snapshot, `watch` to stream)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print the cached per-capability provider health (use --refresh to bypass the cache)

flags.name: refresh
flags.description: Bypass the cache and re-run every checker before printing

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Stream rollup events; exits on Ctrl-C

groups.name: provider
groups.description: Lifecycle actions on local-tier providers (start/stop/restart, pull-model on ollama, stream logs)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List local providers, their current process_state, and supported actions

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a local provider (use --dry-run to preview)

positionals.name: provider-id
positionals.description: Provider id (e.g. whisper-stt, kokoro-tts, ollama, speaker-verification)

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop a local provider (use --dry-run to preview)

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Restart a local provider (use --dry-run to preview)

commands.name: pull-model
commands.description: Pull a model on the ollama provider (ollama-only; use --dry-run to preview)

positionals.name: model-name
positionals.description: Model identifier accepted by `ollama pull` (e.g. phi3:mini)

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Stream stdout/stderr lines from a provider's backing resource

flags.name: tail
flags.description: Number of historical lines to emit before tailing

groups.name: corpus
groups.description: Manage the speech-eval clip corpus (record-import, list, get, delete). Audio bytes live in the git-ignored blob store; metadata in the corpus SQLite domain.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List corpus clips (newest first), optionally filtered by tag

flags.name: tag
flags.description: Only clips whose tags contain this substring

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Max clips to return (0 = no limit)

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import an s16le-mono-PCM audio file + reference transcript as a corpus clip

positionals.name: audio-file
positionals.description: Path to the audio file (s16le mono PCM preferred — the recorder's format)

flags.name: reference-file
flags.description: Path to a file holding the ground-truth transcript

flags.name: scripted
flags.description: Mark the clip as a scripted-prompt reading (default free-form)

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one corpus clip's metadata

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a corpus clip (metadata row + audio blob)

groups.name: eval
groups.description: Run the STT strategy comparison harness over the corpus and print the WER/compute/latency report.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Replay the corpus through batch + vad-segment + overlap-agree and print the comparison table

flags.name: strategies
flags.description: Comma-separated strategy kinds (batch,vad_segment,overlap_agree); default all three

flags.name: clip-ids
flags.description: Comma-separated clip ids to evaluate (default: whole corpus)

flags.name: realtime-repeats
flags.description: Real-time-paced runs per clip for latency p50/p95 (0 = quality only)

flags.name: output
flags.description: Write the report JSON to this file
